title: Numerical Protection Relay Price in Pakistan 2026 — Overcurrent, Earth Fault, Differential & Distance Relay for 11kV MV/HV Switchgear: Complete Buyer's Guide
summary_html: Pakistan's first comprehensive numerical protection relay buyer guide (2026): ANSI function codes for 11kV systems, IDMT curve selection (IEC 60255-151 SI/VI/EI), DISCO protection requirements per LESCO/K-Electric/FESCO/IESCO, CT & VT selection (class 5P20/PS, ALF criteria), auxiliary DC battery sizing, IEC 61850 vs Modbus RTU for Pakistan 2026, overcurrent/earth fault/differential/distance relay price table in PKR, Protection Commissioning Test Report (PCTR) 14-step checklist, 6 expensive installer mistakes, and relay-to-application selection matrix. Covers relay types from basic 50/51/51N to 87T transformer differential to 21 distance relay.
